cohort: 5211 nulliparous women who delivered a live-born infant at ≥37 weeks of gestation between January 2015 and December 2019 at a tertiary maternity hospital in Switzerland.
finding: Advanced maternal age (≥40 years) is associated with an increased risk of unscheduled cesarean delivery among nulliparas.
mod_finding: Among vaginal deliveries, assisted procedures were performed more frequently in the advanced maternal age group compared to the younger group.
